title: Vodka Slush
description: This frozen vodka slush is flavored with orange, lemonade, and tea. To serve, mix with lemon-lime soda. Great for parties!
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen lemonade concentrate

steps.text: In a 6-quart pot combine sugar and 7 cups water; bring to a boil and stir until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat and stir in tea powder while hot. Add orange juice concentrate, lemonade concentrate, and 2 cups cold water. Chill in the refrigerator.
When cold mix in vodka. Pour into a plastic container leaving room on top for expansion. Freeze for 24 hours.
To serve, scoop about 1 cup into a tall glass and quickly stir in 1/3 cup lemon-lime soda.
